answers.core: This is change of core feature, not new one.
answers.workaround:
It can be almost done with:
export -> Options -> Embede PCK
export -> Resources -> Filters or Exclude Files  set to * (this will throw error right now -  "Must select at least one file to export.")
manualy copping resources to game folder
modders have to ZIP mod files in single zip file

title: Modding support - option to just copy resource folders and files (don't put them into PCK, ZIP or EXE)
